extracted.name: Tropical beer cocktail
extracted.description: Evoke memories of relaxing at your favourite beach with this sensational beer-based tropical fruit cocktail, with vodka and watermelon syrup
ingredient_lines: ¾ -1 tsp watermelon syrup (or regular sugar syrup)
slice of fresh watermelon to garnish
instruction_lines: Splash the rim of your short glass with water and apply sugar to the whole rim. Put the sugar on a plate and dunk in the rim, if it's easier.
Pour in the beer, vodka and syrup, then mix well. Fill with crushed ice, then wedge a slice of fresh watermelon on the edge of the glass to serve.
